note: insert_colorbox is a submodule of Insert. It adds colorbox__<image-style> insert styles (hook_insert_styles, image type) and renders them via hook_insert_render + the insert_colorbox_image theme hook. Its persistent state is the config object insert_colorbox.config (shipped defaults style: image, gallery: '0'), whose two fields (style, gallery) are injected into the shared Insert settings form (route insert.config, /admin/config/content/insert, permission 'administer filters') via hook_insert_config_form. style = image style shown inside the colorbox (an image style name, 'image' for original, or '0' to reuse the widget 'Link image to' setting). gallery = post | page | field_post | field_page | 0 (no gallery). Depends on colorbox + insert. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real insert_colorbox.config object read/written via drush; scripts restore shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: The Drupal insert_colorbox submodule has no dedicated settings page. Which config object stores its two settings, what are those two keys, and where in the admin UI do you edit them?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in the config object insert_colorbox.config with keys 'style' (image style shown inside the colorbox) and 'gallery' (gallery grouping mode). They are edited on the shared Insert settings form at /admin/config/content/insert (an Insert Colorbox fieldset injected via hook_insert_config_form).

evals.prompt: What are the valid values of the insert_colorbox 'gallery' setting, and what does each do for images inserted into body text?
evals.expected_output: gallery accepts: post (one Colorbox gallery per node/post), page (one gallery for the whole page), field_post (per field within a post), field_page (per field on the page), or 0 (no gallery, each image opens alone).

evals.prompt: How does insert_colorbox make its lightbox option show up as an insert 'style' in a Drupal image field's Insert settings, and how are those style names named?
evals.expected_output: insert_colorbox implements hook_insert_styles for the image insert type and adds one insert style per image style named colorbox__<image-style> (label 'Colorbox <style>'). Selecting one in a field widget's Insert styles makes that Colorbox option available when inserting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, insert_colorbox has been configured with a non-default gallery grouping and colorbox image style. Inspect the live configuration and report the current values of the gallery mode and the image style shown inside the colorbox.
evals.expected_output: insert_colorbox.config currently has gallery = page (one Colorbox gallery for the whole page) and style = thumbnail (the thumbnail image style is shown inside the colorbox).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure insert_colorbox so that images inserted via Colorbox are grouped into one gallery per post (node). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set insert_colorbox.config gallery = post (e.g. drush cset insert_colorbox.config gallery post -y, or choose 'Per post gallery' in the Insert Colorbox fieldset on the Insert settings form).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, insert_colorbox has a non-default gallery grouping and colorbox image style. Inspect the live configuration and report the current gallery mode and the image style shown inside the colorbox.
evals.expected_output: insert_colorbox.config currently has gallery = field_page (one gallery per field on the whole page) and style = medium (the medium image style is shown inside the colorbox). Read with drush cget insert_colorbox.config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure insert_colorbox so that the image shown inside the Colorbox lightbox is rendered with the 'large' image style. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set insert_colorbox.config style = large (e.g. drush cset insert_colorbox.config style large -y, or choose the 'large' image style in the Insert Colorbox fieldset on the Insert settings form).
